scope: Source-pinned operation measurements; application capacity is a separate required dimension. Unautomated charter clauses remain INSUFFICIENT even when their numeric subgates pass. PASS is not a power-loss certification or a deployment decision.

dimensions.note: Flat versus history length: at every swept length native P50 <= sidecar P50, and native growth from the shortest length stays inside its repeat-measured range or no steeper than the sidecar's growth in the same run.

Raw SQLite is a narrower engine floor, not semantic equivalence. A named structural cause explains an over-budget observation but does not turn the numerical gate into PASS. Lifecycle process boundaries are explicitly excluded from this floor, not from maintenance.
Shutdown/checkpoint, reopen and first-read clocks are separate; no reopen-only lifecycle win.

The witness runs the receipt's pinned executable as a separate serve process on the receipt's volume: a second authority must be refused, and every write acknowledged before a mid-write SIGKILL must read back exactly after reopen. The sidecar's witness must be present; its outcome is reported, not charged to native.

Two CPUs satisfy the charter's fewer-than-4-cores condition. The charter defines no numeric no-blow-up budget: a complete witness reports matched native idle/pressure P99 cohorts and their ratio (sidecar ratio as context, never a substitute) and stays INSUFFICIENT: budget requires owner decision.
Reads must not block the writer: for every N the native writer slowdown versus writer-only stays inside its repeat-measured range or no worse than the sidecar's WAL-reader slowdown in the same run.
